Radiology Report
Date: 09/10/2026
Patient: Sophie Lubowitz, 65 y/o F

Indication: Evaluation of lumbar spine.

Findings:
MRI 09/10/2026: L2 compression fx, marrow edema on STIR.
No other acute fractures identified. No paraspinal soft tissue abnormality.
Intervertebral discs show mild degenerative changes without significant herniation.
Spinal canal and neural foramina are patent.

Impression:
L2 compression fracture with marrow edema consistent with acute/subacute injury.
No additional acute osseous or soft tissue abnormalities.
